PRIUS BRAND & BUSINESS Partners is a premier strategic communications consultancy specializing in public relations, brand positioning, media advocacy, and corporate reputation management. At Eptura, we're not just another tech company—we're a global leader transforming the way people, workplaces, and assets connect. Working closely with members of our HR team in India and around the world, you will gain practical exposure across the employee lifecycle while supporting day-to-day HR programs, processes, and employee initiatives.
